references.text: He heals those who have a broken heart and binds up their wounds.

Truly, he took on our sicknesses and carried our pains. Yet we considered him to be afflicted, struck by God and mistreated. But he was wounded for our transgressions, crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought us peace was upon him, and by his wounds we have been healed.
Therefore Jesus also suffered outside the gate, so as to sanctify the people through his own blood.
